mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an accommodative monetary policy shift that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower financing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% for two consecutive months signals severe labor market deterioration that precedes economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as earnings expectations fall.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing supply chain disruption (INDPRO < 90.0) during high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) reduces corporate profitability through input cost pressures, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as earnings growth stalls.
regime_hint: high inflation and supply chain disruption
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 90.0 and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY, or regime-specific Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 500.0 thousand units for two consecutive months signals weakening residential construction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 500.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous inflation acceleration (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY) and stable monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 0.25%) signal persistent inflationary pressures that force equity valuations to contract, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 0.25%, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained nonfarm payroll growth (PAYEMS > 100k monthly) over three consecutive months indicates robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS grows for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% YoY), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals imminent economic peak as consumer spending weakens, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as earnings growth decelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 2.0% YoY and RSAFS declines, or regime-specific Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
